description: Six-probe kill-test results spanning L0 (CMB) to L3 (dwarf galaxy).

probes.name: DDO 154 rotation curve
probes.note: NFW residuals +/- 9 km/s; EFC within +/- 1 km/s

probes.name: Multi-component SPARC refit
probes.note: NGC 7331 Delta AIC = -126; NGC 4138 Delta AIC = -86; 175-galaxy extension pending

probes.name: Bullet Cluster
probes.note: EFC uses observable gas-shock entropy; LCDM requires 85% invisible mass

probes.name: CMB primary
probes.note: alpha_S -> 0 at z > 1100; no deviation from LCDM predictions

probes.name: A_L / (mu, Sigma) lensing anomaly
probes.note: MGCAMB run; (mu, Sigma) from single slip counter-term

probes.name: Cobaya minimize full chain
probes.note: Best of four runs: (K0, m^2) bobyqa minimum

non_rejectability_test.criterion: No probe LCDM or LCDM_decisive; at least one probe EFC or EFC_decisive
non_rejectability_test.note: EFC survives kill-test; still requires full MCMC for Bayesian model comparison.
